title: Diagram Recall and Route Notation — Enrollment Review
summary: Current administrative record for the paused Diagram Recall and Route Notation enrollment screen and protocol-material review.

sections.title: ADMINISTRATIVE RECORD
sections.body:
**Study reference:** ST-25-009

**Protocol revision:** 1.0

**Responsible unit:** Participant Programs Office

**Administrative state:** Enrollment paused

**Effective date:** 2025-06-12

**Personnel record:** Role-only working copy

sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:
**Objective:** Maintain the protocol in a paused enrollment state while the diagram set, response timing, and participant instructions receive ordinary materials review.

**Scope limitation:** This administrative copy contains no enrollment record, participant roster, contact details, or response data.

sections.title: METHOD & OBSERVATIONS
sections.body:
**Administrative review:** Confirmed that the public page accurately describes one short diagram-recall and route-notation session and does not imply active enrollment.

**Observation:** Public protocol language and exclusions remain suitable for display. The participation screen remains unavailable while the material set is under review.

sections.title: DISPOSITION
sections.body:
**Disposition:** Retain the protocol in paused status.

**Next review:** Reconcile the next diagram-set revision with timing instructions before reopening an eligibility screen.

**Review status:** Administrative review remains open.
